summary: W. P. Carey Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its tenant Hellweg Die Profi-Baumärkte GmbH & Co. KG filed for insolvency under self-administration. W. P. Carey net leases 16 properties to Hellweg with annualized base rent of approximately $15.2 million. Rent has been paid through May 2026. Bank guarantees cover three months of rent. Binding agreements have been executed to lease eight stores to other operators at comparable rents, with leases commencing upon Hellweg lease termination and downtime of three to nine months. AFFO guidance of $5.16 to $5.26 per share is maintained. This is a tenant credit event disclosure, not a special situation requiring category assignment.
